question: How can one become lord of all accomplishments without self-accomplishment?
premises: Being lord of all accomplishments is considered
Self-accomplishment is the basis in question
The question implies impossibility without that basis
inference: One cannot become lord of all accomplishments otherwise than through the accomplishment of one's own self.
plain_english: Otherwise, how could I be the lord of all accomplishments, except through the accomplishment of my own self?
